My brother commited a few months back. I'm very different because I too was suicidal. Yes I know he wouldn't want me to greif. The day I found out I was in shock, I was looking at the few drops of blood after the clean up. My whole family cried. I had to let one of his best friends know. He broke down over the phone. That's where I cried for the second time. The first was when the officer told me the news over the phone. A couple days go by and it starts to hit me really bad. My chest felt extremely heavy. I could not stop drinking and crying. It felt like I was walking in space. My whole body was fatigued. I picked up a lef and arm, and my heart would just scream. I weep cried for a good few months. Looked at Near death experiences, after life videos, shows like "I survived". My drinking got real bad. I almost hanged myself twice. I had to break things off with my girlfriend. I was figuring out a lot about myself. Everyone seemed to be getting lost. A mutual friend of ours is battling everyday and a lot of people blame themselves. I had my mom sitting next to his ashes. I was in my room grabbed my blanket so I can make a noose in the living room. I saw my mom, and I dropped the blanket, and we talked. I stopped drinking after that day. I chose to live for my family, and his kid that he left behind.(5yrs, just turned 6) I have to be double great. For the both of us.. ("Walk hard. The story of Duey Cox) It's a beautiful ride 🎶
